definition: YWHAZ is a gene encoding tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein zeta (a member of the 14-3-3 protein family), heterozygous pathogenic variants in which cause Popov-Chang syndrome (OMIM #618428), an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder.

source.title: 618428 - POPOV-CHANG SYNDROME; POPCHAS
source.quote: Caused by mutation in the tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan ・ activation protein, zeta isoform gene (YWHAZ, 601288.0001)
